question: Nirvik (Niryat Rin Vikas Yojana) scheme announced in 2020-21 Union Budget is related to which component of the export credit?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Insurance**__**.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Nirvik (Niryat Rin Vikas Yojana)** scheme **announced in 2020-2the 1 Union Budget** is related to the **insurance **component of the** export credit.**
 
• It will **provide high insurance cover **for **exporters **and **reduce premiums** for **small exporters.**
 
• **Under** the Scheme, the** Export Credit Insurance Scheme (ECIS),** the** insurance guarantee** could **cover up to 90% **of the **principal and interest.**
 
• The** scheme** is being prepared by the** Commerce and Industry Ministry.**
 
• **Commerce and Industry Ministry **has also **proposed to subsidize **the premium under the Scheme that has to be paid by **exporters** of certain key sectors.
